messages:
maria: CI on infra repo is flaking hard — multiple GH Actions runs over the last 2 hours failed. Symptoms: self-hosted runner autoscaler not spawning runners, cache restore 403s from S3, and terraform apply stuck on remote state lock. This is blocking GPU pool provisioning (dedicated capacity churn). Anyone else seeing this?

trevor: seeing the same. On my side runner pods created by runner-autoscaler get CrashLoopBackOff. K8s events show API 503 when creating pods, then GH run times out waiting for a runner and the concurrency setting cancels older attempts. Logs excerpt:```
2026-03-18T14:10:12Z runner: registering...
2026-03-18T14:10:20Z runner: registration timed out
2026-03-18T14:12:01Z actions/cache: Failed to restore cache
HTTP response status code: 403
---
Error: Failed to restore cache (403)
```

ashwin: 403 on cache could be S3 bucket policy or the IAM role the runners use. We rotated the cross-account role for backups last week — might have clobbered the actions role binding. Pinging storage infra to confirm.

jen: storage team replied they pushed a policy tweak around 14:00 but claimed it only affected backup-role. Need the exact resource ARN the GH cache uses to double-check. @ashwin can you paste the cache key from a failed run?

trevor: here's the cache step from the workflow that failed:```yaml
- name: Restore node_modules cache
  uses: actions/cache@v4
  with:
    path: .gha-cache
    key: infra-${{ runner.os }}-deps-${{ hashFiles('**/go.sum') }}
    restore-keys: |
      infra-${{ runner.os }}-deps-
```
Failed runs show the same 403 when calling S3 PUT/GET. Some runs also aborted because our workflow concurrency is set to 1 for branch protection, so later runs cancel earlier ones while waiting for a runner.

samir: terraform side note — remote state backend (consul) returned 500 intermittently which caused the state lock to be orphaned. When that happens subsequent `terraform apply` gets stuck on lock. I added a retry wrapper for the `apply` step locally but we should add more robust retry/backoff and a clearer runbook for `terraform force-unlock` if necessary. Also suggest increasing the lock TTL in consul for big infra applies.

maria: two-pronged ask: 1) temporary mitigation so GPU provisioning can finish (switch critical branches to GH-hosted runners or allow concurrency=2), 2) longer-term fixes (runner-autoscaler healthchecks + k8s API error handling, cache policy audit, state backend retrying). Cost for hosted runners is fine short-term.

trevor: I can open a quick PR to add a workflow fallback to hosted runners for the gpu-provision job and increase concurrency to 2 for main branches. Also will change cache key strategy to include region/role hash to avoid hitting wrong bucket ACLs and add `restore-keys` fallback. For terraform I'll add a retry loop around `terraform init`/`apply` with exponential backoff. Draft command snippet:```bash
RETRIES=5; i=0; until terraform apply -auto-approve; do
  i=$((i+1)); if [ $i -ge $RETRIES ]; then echo "apply failed after $i attempts"; exit 1; fi; sleep $((i*15)); done
```

jen: I'll write a short runbook with manual unlock steps and who to page. Manual commands:```bash
# If a lock looks orphaned
terraform force-unlock LOCK_ID state.tfstate
# consul: check /v1/kv/terraform-locks
```
I'll add it to the infra runbook and link from the pipeline failure message.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: 1769346000 - canary apply for rtx-pool failed: consul state backend returned 500 -> state lock timeout. Auto-retry scheduled in 5m.

maria: thanks — assigning to @trevor to land the workflow fallback & retries. I'll follow up with storage infra for the S3 policy/role mapping. Can we also tag this as P2 incident so we get on-call eyes? :facepalm:

trevor: on it. Opening PR now (WIP): https://github.com/redwood-infra/infra/pull/432 — includes hosted-runner-fallback, cache key tweak, and simple terraform retry wrapper. Will also add an opt-in `SKIP_STATE_LOCK` flag for emergency unlocks.

ashwin: pinged storage infra (ticket #ST-2187) with the failing run logs and cache key. They acknowledged and will revert policy change if needed.

maria: great. keep updates here. If anyone sees more 503s from k8s API, pls paste the node controller logs.

samir: added a short helper script to the repo: `scripts/retry-apply.sh` — will include in the PR as well.

trevor: PR ready for review, tests passing locally. Will merge if no objections in 15m.

maria: merging after checks. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
